items.item: `Sources/Locale Standard/Locale.swift`: `Locale.init(_: BCP47.LanguageTag)` silently drops a nume
items.reason: Chose throw over carry: Locale models only language, script and alpha-2 region; carrying would change the public `region` type and add fields. New Locale.Error (language(ISO_639.Error), unsupportedRegion(String), unsupportedVariants([String]), unsupportedExtensions([BCP47.LanguageTag.Extension]), unsupportedPrivateUse([String])). Tests pin es-419, de-DE-1901, -u- extension, -x- private use and JSON decoding of es-419.

api_changes: Locale.init(_: BCP47.LanguageTag) now throws(Locale.Error) instead of throws(ISO_639.Error)
Behaviour: decoding / string literal of a tag with numeric region, variant, extension or private use now fails (literal traps) instead of yielding a shortened locale
notes: No package under repos/ imports Locale Standard outside this repository, so no dependents to fix.
